$description: FinCore v0.1 token source. Light theme only; dark theme is not implemented. Canonical names are dot-separated groups with hyphenated state suffixes. Primitive values are the reference palette; semantic and component tokens must alias rather than repeat literals.

white.$description: Reference white. Aliased by light surfaces and primary foregrounds.

black.$description: Reference black. Reserved; no v0.1 semantic token aliases it.

space.$description: Primitive spacing steps required by the v0.1 components.

lg.$description: Concentric focus-ring radius: control radius 6px plus focus offset 2px. Keeps the ring corner gap even without a literal.

border.$description: Control boundary width. Button is borderless; form controls are not.

color.$description: Semantic color tokens. Light theme only, values unchanged from docs/foundation/color-system.md. Components consume button.* component tokens.

helper.$description: Supporting helper text. Passes 4.5:1 for 12px text on every supported light surface, unlike content.tertiary. Dark-mode mapping pending.

control.$description: Interactive control boundary. Meets WCAG 1.4.11 (3:1) on every supported light surface; the subtle/default/strong roles do not.

control-hover.$description: Hovered control boundary, one step above color.border.control. Not supported on inverse surfaces in v0.1.

error.$description: Invalid control boundary. Distinct from color.feedback.error-border, which is a 1.45:1 container tint.

button.$description: Button component tokens. Color tokens alias semantic color tokens; geometry tokens alias primitives because no semantic geometry layer exists yet. Ghost has no default background and renders transparent.

input.$description: Input component tokens. Color tokens alias semantic roles; geometry and typography alias primitives because no semantic geometry layer exists yet. Flat state suffixes match Button. Focus is orthogonal through a separate ring. Inverse surfaces are not a supported Input context in v0.1.

height.$description: Control height. 40px, above the 24px minimum target.

border-width.$description: Inside control boundary. Input is bordered; Button is not.

radius.$description: Concentric ring radius. Must equal input.radius plus input.focus.offset.

background-disabled.$description: Flat muted disabled fill matching Button. Exempt from contrast; visually weak by design.

border-disabled.$description: Matches the disabled fill, so the disabled control has no visible boundary.

select.$description: Select component tokens. Mirrors Input geometry and color roles. Color tokens alias semantic roles; geometry and typography alias primitives. Focus is orthogonal through a separate ring. Light theme only.

radius.$description: Concentric ring radius. Must equal select.radius plus select.focus.offset.

phone-input.$description: PhoneInput component tokens. Inherits from Input patterns but adds country selector layout tokens. Color tokens alias semantic roles; geometry and typography alias primitives because no semantic geometry layer exists yet. Focus is orthogonal through a separate ring.

height.$description: Control height. 40px, above the 24px minimum target.

gap.$description: Gap between country selector and number input.

radius.$description: Concentric ring radius. Must equal phone-input.radius plus phone-input.focus.offset.

background-disabled.$description: Flat muted disabled fill matching Input. Exempt from contrast; visually weak by design.

border-disabled.$description: Matches the disabled fill, so the disabled control has no visible boundary.

checkbox.$description: Checkbox component tokens. Geometry and color roles consistent with Input/Select. Focus is orthogonal through a separate ring. Light theme only.

radius.$description: Concentric ring radius. Must equal checkbox.radius plus checkbox.focus.offset (4px + 2px = 6px).

radio-group.$description: Radio Group component tokens. Geometry and color roles consistent with Checkbox/Select. Light theme only.

helper-gap.$description: Gap between radio group and helper/error (4px).

textarea.$description: Textarea component tokens. Mirrors Input geometry, padding and color roles with multi-line min-height. Light theme only.

min-height.$description: Default minimum height for multiline textarea.

radius.$description: Concentric ring radius. Must equal textarea.radius plus textarea.focus.offset.

otp.$description: OTP input component tokens. Fixed number of single-character cells. Mirrors Input geometry and color roles with cell-level square sizing. Light theme only.

label-gap.$description: Gap between label and cells row (8px).

currency.$description: Currency component tokens. Geometry and color roles consistent with Input with prefix/suffix affordances. Light theme only.

affix-gap.$description: Gap between currency prefix/suffix and numeric field.

radius.$description: Concentric ring radius. Must equal currency.radius plus currency.focus.offset.

affix-color.$description: Color for currency prefix symbol or suffix code.

cvv.$description: CVV component tokens. Mirrors Input/PasswordInput geometry and color roles for a short fixed-length masked security code input with optional visibility toggle. Light theme only.

height.$description: Control height. 40px, above the 24px minimum target.

letter-spacing.$description: Letter spacing for masked code digits.

radius.$description: Concentric ring radius. Must equal cvv.radius plus cvv.focus.offset.

date-picker.$description: DatePicker component tokens. Mirrors Input geometry and color roles for a native date input with calendar trigger and segment support. Light theme only.

height.$description: Control height. 40px, above the 24px minimum target.

radius.$description: Concentric ring radius. Must equal date-picker.radius plus date-picker.focus.offset.
